legend: The Curupira (Amazon rainforest, Brazilian forest-spirit folklore)
lines: Deep in the Amazon rainforest, hunters speak of the Curupira.
A small forest spirit with flaming red hair.
But look at his feet, because they point backward.
So anyone who follows his tracks walks straight away from him and gets lost.
The Curupira guards the animals, and he hates hunters who take too many.
He whistles from the trees, and travelers wander in circles for days.
They say a gift of tobacco may calm him.
Treat the forest with respect, and maybe he will let you go.
Is the Curupira only a story? What do you think?
title: The Curupira: The Forest Spirit With Backwards Feet #shorts
description:
In the Amazon rainforest, hunters tell of the Curupira, a small spirit with flaming red hair and feet that point backward, so his tracks lead you astray.
